written_from: IBM z/OS MVS JCL User's Guide (Appendix A, generation data sets) and JCL Reference (JOB: RESTART, JCLLIB ORDER); GDG DDs inside procedures that are JCLLIB library members, under JOB RESTART. Written before the resolver ran. Not run on the MVS 3.8J box (no library). Assumption A9 is in gdg/scenarios.json.
library_jcl: //* #8413 restart, GDG DDs in library procedures (JCLLIB members).

scenarios.basis: z/OS MVS JCL User's Guide (SA23-0393 / ieab500), Appendix A, 'Restarting a job with generation data sets' p. 243, and z/OS MVS JCL Reference (SA23-1385 / ieab600), JOB: RESTART p. 431. RESTART=CALL1.G3 is a step restart of the library member found first on JCLLIB ORDER=(LIB.A,LIB.B) (RPRC of LIB.A: G1, G2, G3). The first run (catalog 6, 7) created and cataloged 8 (G1's +1) and 9 (G2's +2); the restart finds 6, 7, 8, 9 and uses the PRESENT numbers: (0) is 9 and (-1) is 8. G1 and G2 do not run again and G3 creates nothing, so the catalog is unchanged.

z/OS MVS JCL User's Guide (SA23-0393 / ieab500), Appendix A, 'Restarting a job with generation data sets' p. 243, and z/OS MVS JCL Reference (SA23-1385 / ieab600), JOB: RESTART p. 431. JCLLIB ORDER=(LIB.B,LIB.A): RPRC is LIB.B's (H1 creates (+1), H2 reads (+1)). RESTART=CALL1.H1 skips only U1, which creates nothing, so the restart finds 6, 7. H1's (+1) is 8 and H2's (+1) names the same generation (the relationship is fixed at the first relative reference of the job); 8 is rolled in at job end.

z/OS MVS JCL User's Guide (SA23-0393 / ieab500), Appendix A, 'Restarting a job with generation data sets' p. 243, and z/OS MVS JCL Reference (SA23-1385 / ieab600), JOB: RESTART p. 431. 'For checkpoint restart: you can refer to generation data sets created and cataloged in steps before the restart step by the same relative generation numbers that were used to create them.' RESTART=(CALL1.D3,CK2) with a SYSCHK DD is a deferred checkpoint restart into LIB.A's RPRD; applying the same-numbers rule to the deferred form is ASSUMED A9. The original run began with 6, 7: D1's (+1) is 8 and D2's (+2) is 9, both cataloged before the restart step, and D3 names them by (+1) and (+2) again: 8 and 9.

z/OS MVS JCL User's Guide (SA23-0393 / ieab500), Appendix A, 'Restarting a job with generation data sets' p. 243, and z/OS MVS JCL Reference (SA23-1385 / ieab600), JOB: RESTART p. 431. JCLLIB ORDER=(LIB.B,LIB.A) makes RPRC LIB.B's member. RESTART=(CALL1.H2,CK1) with a SYSCHK DD: the original run began with 6, 7 and H1 created and cataloged (+1) = 8 before the restart step; H2 reads it by the number that created it, (+1), so 8 (same-numbers rule for the deferred form is ASSUMED A9). Nothing new is created, and 8 stays cataloged.

refused.construct: a step restart into a library procedure whose restart step reads a generation by the number that created it in a step before the restart step, (+1)
refused.reason: JCL Reference p. 431: the original relative generation numbers are not used in the restart step; the manual states no outcome, so refused as read before any step creates it

refused.construct: a checkpoint restart into a library procedure of a job with GDGBIAS=STEP
refused.reason: the manuals state the checkpoint rule by the numbers that created the generations, not how a per-step relationship is rebuilt; refused by name
